Atrium Play-by-Play

Source: R/atrium.R
atrium_pbp.Rd

One game's play-by-play: every event with the period clock, the player and the running score.

Endpoint: GET https://embed-api.eui.connect.sportradar.com/v1/embed/{website_id}/fixture_detail?sub=pbp

sequence is the 1-based position in the body (periods in order, events chronological within a period). clock is the time REMAINING in the period as sent (PT10M0S at the start) and clock_seconds its value. home_score / away_score are the running score after the event. x / y (shots only) are percent of the court (0-100). Team events have no person_id. Overtime is period_id 11+.

Usage

atrium_pbp(website_id, fixture_id, locale = NULL)

Arguments

website_id

(integer required): Site config id: which league site's widget this is (12 LNB France, 14 LNBP Mexico, 3 NBL1 Australia, 13 El Salvador, 22 Panama, 236 Austria, 326 Montenegro). Not a league id: one site serves several competitions.

fixture_id

(character required): Game UUID (fixture_id in atrium_fixtures()), e.g. "0dc631bd-c34c-11f1-8d16-4d5a21afb79d".

locale

(character optional): Locale of the labels, e.g. "en-EN" or "fr-FR". Omitted = the site's own language. Ids and codes never change.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble, one row per event_id:

col_nametypedescription
website_idintegerSite config id the body came from (12 LNB, 14 LNBP, 3 NBL1, 13 El Salvador, 22 Panama, 236 Austria, 326 Montenegro), read from the body's links.self.
fixture_idcharacterGame UUID (fixture); the key of every game frame and of the fixture_detail routes.
season_idcharacterSeason UUID of the game.
sequenceinteger1-based position of the event in the game (periods in order, events chronological).
event_idcharacterEvent UUID, shared with the same event in atrium_shots.
period_idintegerPeriod number: 1-4 regulation, 11, 12, ... overtimes (not 5).
clockcharacterTime REMAINING in the period as an ISO 8601 duration (PT10M0S at the start).
clock_secondsintegerSeconds remaining in the period, parsed from clock.
entity_idcharacterTeam UUID the event is credited to.
sidecharacterSide of the game the row belongs to: home or away (from the fixture's isHome flag).
person_idcharacterPlayer UUID; null for team events (time-outs, team rebounds).
person_namecharacterPlayer the event is credited to; null for team events (time-outs, team rebounds).
bibcharacterJersey number of the player, as text; null for team events.
event_typecharacterEvent type: 2pt, 3pt, freeThrow, rebound, assist, steal, block, turnover, foul, substitution, timeOut, jumpBall, ... (language-independent).
event_sub_typecharacterEvent detail: jumpShot, layup, offensive, defensive, in, out, 1Of2, personal, ...; null when none.
descriptioncharacterThe event's text in the site's language (e.g. Entre-deux remporte).
successlogicalTrue when a shot or free throw was made, false when missed; null for other events.
success_labelcharacterThe made / missed label in the site's language; sent on shot events only.
xdoubleShot location along the 28 m court length as percent of the court (0-100, origin at a corner); the home team attacks the low-x basket all game; null for non-shots.
ydoubleShot location across the 15 m width as percent of the court (0-100); which sideline is 0 is unverified; null for non-shots.
home_scoreintegerHome team's running score after the event.
away_scoreintegerAway team's running score after the event.

Details

Unofficial. This is the public endpoint the Sportradar Atrium / Synergy "Connect" widget calls from every visitor's browser (keyless; the host has no robots.txt). The data is Sportradar's and the leagues'. The wrappers read it on the caller's behalf, one request at least 1 s after the last to the host, and it is not republished as release assets. Keep crawls small and incremental.

Sites and seasons. website_id picks the league site; one site carries many competitions. Seasons are END years (season = 2026): the site's own year is the START year on LNB and the calendar year elsewhere, and a year can hold several competitions, so pair season with competition_id (see atrium_seasons()) or pass season_id. atrium_end_year() maps a site's own year to that END year, and atrium_season_id() finds the season UUID.

Columns are configured per site: a statistic one site omits is NA. A key the documented columns do not list is appended with an inferred type. Player and team ids (UUIDs, character) are shared across sites; the player stat tables carry names only, so person_id there is decoded from the widget link beside each name.

Errors (classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error): hoopR_no_data when the site has nothing for the request (HTTP 404, no such season, an empty fixture list, a game with no play-by-play yet, or a fixture id the site does not serve: an unknown id or a game of another site, which the API answers alike with an empty fixture); hoopR_bad_request for HTTP 400 / 422 or an argument that cannot be mapped (an ambiguous END year, season with season_id); hoopR_asset_fetch for any other failed fetch, an error / stub body, or a body that belongs to another site, type, season, game, player or team than the one asked for.
